figures.label: Figure 1
figures.caption: SARS-CoV’s viral invasion of the host cell via a membrane-bound ACE-2 receptor. ACE-2 mediates entry of coronavirus in two distinct ways. The first one is Clathrin and ADAM 17-dependent endocytosis, and the second one is TMPRSS2-dependent membrane fusion. Figure replicated from [6] with permission.
